sentences.text:
2) Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the accident had taken place in the year 1998 and at that time, CIDC/petitioner was not in existence, therefore,
liability cannot be fastened with the petitioner and this aspect of the matter has not been taken into consideration by the learned Claims Tribunal and even by the Executing Court.

Therefore, he would pray to quash the execution proceeding pending before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, South Bastar, Dantewada (C.G.)
3) On the other hand, learned counsel for the Claimants would submit that the present petition is not maintainable as the award has already been passed and liability has been fastened with the petitioner and the petitioner ought to have filed an appeal according to provisions of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
4) I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents.
5) From the perusal of the documents, it appears that in Claim Case No.16/1999,
Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Bastar, Jagdalpur passed an award of Rs.6,93,424/- in favour of the Claimants and the petitioner was directed to make payment of compensation.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, South Bastar, Dantewada
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The claimants filed an execution case before the Executing Court and to quash the execution proceedings, the petitioner has filed the instant petition on the ground that the accident had taken place prior to the bifurcation of the State of Madhya Pradesh, therefore, liability cannot be fastened with the petitioner.
6) In the present case, the petitioner has not challenged the award whereby liability has been fastened.
The execution proceedings pending before the Executing Court are the outcome of the award passed by the learned Claims Tribunal.
The petitioner ought to have preferred an appeal according to provisions of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act to challenge the award.
7) Taking into consideration the above-stated aspect, this petition is not maintainable.

Sd/-
